compiled_state.title: Wire Makefile.audit target orchestrating audit_dd1..dd5 in dep order
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
(Infrastructure task — each DD owned by task-1..task-5; this Makefile binds them so operator can run full per-phase audit via 'make audit-phase PHASE=N'.)

Create plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/Makefile.audit defining target audit-phase requiring PHASE=<n>. Invokes audits in dep order: dd4 (gate) → dd1 (baseline) → dd2 (orphan diff) → dd3 (mutation caps) → dd5 (bundler). Any non-zero short-circuits. .PHONY + help target.

## Test Approach
Given audit script stubs all exit 0 in order; When make -f Makefile.audit audit-phase PHASE=2 runs; Then all 5 execute in order dd4→dd1→dd2→dd3→dd5 (verified via call-order stub) + exit 0. Given dd2 stub exits 4; Then dd3+dd5 NOT invoked + target exits non-zero.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] audit-phase invokes audits in dd4→dd1→dd2→dd3→dd5 order
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_makefile_audit.sh::test_invocation_order
- [ ] Non-zero from earlier audit short-circuits later audits
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_makefile_audit.sh::test_short_circuit_on_failure
- [ ] Missing PHASE variable produces clear usage error
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_makefile_audit.sh::test_missing_phase_var

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/Makefile.audit — Create
- tests/unit/scripts/test_makefile_audit.sh — Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2: (a) Exit-code propagation — Makefile rules MUST propagate non-zero exit from any sub-script (especially task-4 audit_dd3_mutation_caps.py) as Makefile failure. Use bash strict mode (set -e) in Makefile recipes OR use Make's default exit-on-error. Add RED test: mock task-4 to exit non-zero → make audit-phase exits non-zero with the same exit code. (b) e2e smoke test via dry-run — invoke 'make -n audit-live PHASE=bootstrap-throttle' (dry-run mode, prints execution plan without running); assert plan contains dd4→dd1→dd2→dd3→dd5 in order. Validates DAG without side-effects.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: FINAL_REMEDIATION: Define audit step names as shared Makefile constants. In Makefile.audit: DD4_STEP := dd4-phase-gate, DD1_STEP := dd1-baseline, DD2_STEP := dd2-orphan-count, DD3_STEP := dd3-mutation-caps, DD5_STEP := dd5-bundle. The audit-phase target uses $(DD4_STEP) $(DD1_STEP) $(DD2_STEP) $(DD3_STEP) $(DD5_STEP) in prerequisites. make -n smoke test asserts the printed plan contains the constants resolved in dependency order. Reduces rename-induced drift: a script rename only requires updating ONE constant, not every place the name appears.
comments.author: Test
